entries.title: Psalms 132:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> Lord, give thought to David, and to all his troubles;

entries.title: Psalms 132:2
segments: How he made an oath to the Lord, and gave his word to the great God of Jacob, saying,

entries.title: Psalms 132:3
segments: Truly, I will not come into my house, or go to my bed,

entries.title: Psalms 132:4
segments: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or rest to my eyeballs,

entries.title: Psalms 132:5
segments: Till I have got a place for the Lord, a resting-place for the great God of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 132:6
segments: We had news of it at Ephrathah: we came to it in the fields of the wood.

entries.title: Psalms 132:7
segments: Let us go into his tent; let us give worship at his feet.

entries.title: Psalms 132:8
segments: Come back, O Lord, to your resting-place; you and the ark of your strength.

entries.title: Psalms 132:9
segments: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints give cries of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:10
segments: Because of your servant David, do not give up your king.

entries.title: Psalms 132:11
segments: ¶The Lord gave a true oath to David, which he will not take back, saying, I will give your kingdom to the fruit of your body.

entries.title: Psalms 132:12
segments: If your children keep my word, and the teachings which I will give them, their children will be rulers of your kingdom for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 132:13
segments: For the Lord's heart is on Zion, desiring it for his resting-place.

entries.title: Psalms 132:14
segments: This is my rest for ever: here will I ever be; for this is my desire.

entries.title: Psalms 132:15
segments: My blessing will be on her food; and her poor will be full of bread.

entries.title: Psalms 132:16
segments: Her priests will be clothed with salvation; and her saints will give cries of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 132:17
segments: There I will make the horn of David fertile: I have made ready a light for my king.

entries.title: Psalms 132:18
segments: His haters will be clothed with shame; but I will make his crown shining.
